0.text: Got a job for you, {runner}. Take out Redbite, the gang boss squeezing the Lower Slums.

1.text: His thugs and Arconan security drones are in every alley. Grab any useful gear you find and bolt it on.

2.text: Not a bad first step for a nameless merc becoming a legend.

3.text: Hold out about ten minutes and Redbite will show up himself. Good luck.

0.text: Redbite's down? The slums will be quiet for a while. Nice work, {runner}.

1.text: Next job. Arconan is stamping out combat mechs in an Industrial Zone factory. Shut the line down.

2.text: Problem is, no weapons are allowed inside that factory. Pass the checkpoint and your combat cyberware gets locked too.

3.text: You want me to walk into a mech factory empty-handed?

4.text: My inside contact will smuggle in your main weapon and one piece of gear you really need. Find the rest in there.

5.text: And watch the floor conveyors. The ground will drag you around.

2.name: Corporate Tower
2.ruleHint: When red lines blink, security lasers sweep through

0.text: Hexaward's scrap metal now. The corporate network is going haywire.

1.text: This is it. The Arconan Core at the top of the tower. Shut it down and your name becomes a legend in this city.

2.text: The tower lobby scan is even worse than the factory. Weapons get confiscated and all combat cyberware gets locked.

4.text: My contact will get your main weapon and one piece of gear inside again. Choose carefully what you bring.

5.text: Security laser grids sweep the tower. When red lines blink, get out of the way.
